exchangeFormat: DE: RST + DE county (NDE New Castle / KDE Kent / SDE Sussex). Outside DE: RST + state/province/'DX'. Bands 160-10m. CW/Phone/Digital (CW grouped with digital for points). DE works everyone; non-DE works DE only. (FT8/FT4 via WSJT Field-Day overlay: DE='nA DE' 1A/2A/3A=NDE/KDE/SDE, out='1A '+section/DX — logged county field governs scoring.)

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (counted ONCE PER CONTEST) [× Power Mult — off-log] [+50 e-log — off-log]. Entrant-asymmetric pts: IN-DE Phone 1 / CW+Digital 2; OUT-DE Phone 10 / CW+Digital 20. DE entrant mult = each US state (DC→MD) + Canadian provinces + each DXCC country (not USA); a DE-to-DE QSO scores points only (no mult). Non-DE entrant mult = DE counties NDE/KDE/SDE. DE works everyone; non-DE scores DE contacts only. Mobiles county-change = new QSO + new county; county-line logged as 2 QSOs. Claimed/running — the DEQP committee re-adjudicates. NOT applied (off-log): Power Multiplier (×3 ≤5W / ×2 ≤100W / ×1 >100W, default ×1); +50 electronic-submission bonus; FT8/FT4 WSJT-FD-overlay county encoding (1A/2A/3A) — the logged county field governs.
